Package index

Overview

xrdbi xrdbi-package
xrdbi: 'DBI' Backend for 'xarray' via a Live 'reticulate' Session

Connect

Open a connection to an xarray Dataset and look around it.

xarray() show(<XarrayDriver>) dbUnloadDriver(<XarrayDriver>) dbDataType(<XarrayDriver>)
xarray DBI driver
dbConnect(<XarrayDriver>)

Query

Python statements, compiled selections, dplyr verbs, and whole variables.

dbSendQuery(<XarrayConnection>,<character>) dbBind(<XarrayResult>) show(<XarrayResult>) dbIsValid(<XarrayResult>) dbGetStatement(<XarrayResult>) dbFetch(<XarrayResult>) dbHasCompleted(<XarrayResult>) dbGetRowCount(<XarrayResult>) dbClearResult(<XarrayResult>)
